$Comment: The Sawmiller's Hatchet's own reward table, rolled by SawmillMasterworkBonus whenever a worker wielding the trophy hits its 5-to-20-percent per-cycle chance. TWO byproduct pulls: a masterwork edge saves the offcuts a rougher cut destroys, so the trophy's signature is volume of usable material rather than a larger plank count. Offcuts come from RPG Stations' own shared RPG_Station_Sawmill_Byproducts list, referenced by id through a Droplist container rather than listed here, so retuning what milling yields is one edit in that file and every tier in both mods moves together. Alongside them sits the one thing no find tier pays: a 2 percent chance of a Woodcutting XP boost token (an MMO Skill Tree consumable). At the roughly 15 procs a full session sees, that lands about once every three sessions, which keeps it a genuine surprise rather than a supply line. It carries no essence at all, deliberately: essence is the find ladder's currency and this table is the tool's.
